results.title: India and South Africa Target Deeper Cooperation in Critical Minerals, Pharmaceuticals and Manufacturing
results.description: Goyal said the discussions covered the signing of the Terms of Reference for the India–SACU agreement, the early conclusion of negotiations and cooperation in strategically important sectors including critical minerals, pharmaceuticals and manufacturing.
